summary: Listed as a lookout tower in Craven County, NC, in two sources, with coordinates and county only. No build date, design, height or current status found.

evidence.supports: tower named Pine Cliff in Craven County at the listed coordinates
the list is of North Carolina lookout towers
Forest Lookouts index has a Pine Cliff entry
the Pine Cliff entry is under Craven County

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Only two sources: tnlandforms (county and coordinates) and the Forest Lookouts North Carolina index (name and county, no further detail). The story is below the 120-word floor because the sources support no more than this, and it omits sentences about missing evidence rather than padding. Craven County's Wikipedia article lists a 'Pine Cliff Recreation Area' among its parks, but no source read links it to the tower; no Wikipedia page for the recreation area or the community exists in the cache or on direct fetch. Not used in the story. The tnlandforms code AB2157 is not explained by the page, so it is not used. Search budget ran out, so no search leads were checked. Brief record had no errors. Fact-check 2026-10-21: removed the unsupported 'state's list' wording. Editor may decide whether to publish a story this short.
